name: PermissionGrant - Default (seed v1)
description: One permission node granted to, or denied for, a player or a permission group. Created here, from a player's admin page (grant or deny a node) or in game with /knk user perm. A holder has at most one grant per node, so creating a node the holder already has updates that grant.

steps.description: Who gets the node, and whether it is allowed or denied. You can only grant or deny nodes you hold yourself, and never on your own account.

fields.label: Player or group
fields.description: The player or permission group that gets this node; the list shows both. A group's grants apply to all its members and to groups that inherit from it; a player's own grants win over their groups'.

fields.label: Permission node
fields.description: The dot-separated node the game checks. End it with .* to cover every node under it (knk.admin.*); an exact node wins over a wildcard.

fields.label: Allow
fields.description: Ticked grants the node. Unticked is an explicit deny, which overrides a grant at a less specific level (a player's deny beats a group's grant). A node granted nowhere is denied anyway.

fields.label: Expires
fields.description: Leave empty for a permanent grant. From this moment on the grant is ignored, for example for a temporary perk.
